ticket: Phase 3 step A (supersedes the retracted check_c2_shioda_tate_v3.py, E-010)

step1_not_dihedral.argument: double root ⇒ logarithmic solution (Frobenius) ⇒ local monodromy at 0 is unipotent and ≠ I; no nontrivial unipotent lies in the normalizer of a maximal torus of SL2 (its elements are semisimple or have trace 0)

step2_L2_irreducible.argument: every attainable Σ(residues) of u=y'/y lies in (1/2)ℤ, but no exponent of L2 at ∞ does; so no hyperexponential solution exists

step3_L3_irreducible.argument: Sym² of an irreducible rank-2 system is irreducible unless the monodromy is dihedral (contained in the normalizer of a torus), which step 1 excludes

step4_minimality.argument: an irreducible operator is the minimal-order annihilator of each of its nonzero solutions (a lower-order annihilator would give a nontrivial gcrd, i.e. a proper right factor)

step5_hodge_identification.status: [B] NOT COMPUTED HERE — standard Hodge theory, cited not re-derived
step5_hodge_identification.claim: rank T(X_z) = rank V for very general z, via V ⊆ T (T is Gauss–Manin-flat and contains ω) and T ⊆ V^sat (T is the minimal primitive sub-Hodge-structure containing H^{2,0})
step5_hodge_identification.citation: Huybrechts, Lectures on K3 Surfaces, CUP 2016, ch. 3 §3.1 and ch. 17 §17.1

conditional_on_step5.caveat: value for the VERY GENERAL member; ρ jumps to 20 on a countable dense subset of the base (singular K3s)
